questions.q: Define "context clue" and name the six standard types taught at senior secondary level.
questions.a: A context clue is a hint within the same sentence or surrounding sentences that helps a reader deduce the meaning of an unfamiliar word. The six standard types are: (1) Definition/Explanation, (2) Restatement/Synonym, (3) Contrast/Antonym, (4) Example/Illustration, (5) Inference/General Context, and (6) Word Structure/Morphology (roots, prefixes, suffixes). A wrong answer that lists only "synonym and antonym" reveals the student reduces context clues to binary opposition and misses inference—the most critical type for literary texts where meaning is layered.

questions.q: In the sentence *"eaq'kh oa'kh/j pkSaosQ. iafMr vyksihnhu bl bykosQ osQ lcls izfrf"Br ”kehankj Fks"* (Akhbar Ojha said. Iftar Bahadur was the most loyal servant of this garden), explain how the word *izfrf"Br* (loyal/devoted) is clarified by the *rest of the paragraph* without using a dictionary.
questions.a: The paragraph shows Iftar Bahadur managing the garden single-handedly ("#i;s dk ysu&nsu djrs Fks"), enduring harsh conditions ("cM+k yack&pkSM+k Fkk"), and earning the narrator's trust ("vaxjs”k vI+kQlj muosQ bykosQ esa f'kdkj [ksyus vkrs"). These behavioral examples function as *illustration clues* that define *izfrf"Br* as "steadfast in duty despite hardship." A student who only cites the dictionary meaning "faithful" misses the textual evidence that the author *shows* loyalty through actions, a key analytical distinction for board answers.

questions.q: Apply the *contrast clue* strategy to determine the meaning of *vykSfdd* in the phrase *"vykSfdd ohjrk"* (from the sentence: *¯drq /eZ vykSfdd ohjrk osQ lkFk bl cgqla[;d lsuk osQ lEeq[k vosQyk ioZr dh Hkk¡fr vVy*). Write the antonym context phrase and the inferred meaning.
questions.a: The contrast phrase is *"vfopfyr [kM+k"* (paid/fixed salary) which appears in coordination with *vykSfdd ohjrk* via *lkFk* (with). *vfopfyr* means "remunerated/paid," so *vykSfdd* must mean "unpaid/voluntary/honorary." Inferred meaning: *vykSfdd* = honorary / without salary / voluntary. A wrong answer guessing "difficult" or "hard" shows the student ignored the coordinate structure *X lkFk Y* and failed to see the salary vs. no-salary opposition central to the clerk's exploitation.

questions.q: Analyze how the *morphological structure* of *cjoaQnkth* (cjoaQ + nkth) and its *syntactic position* in *"iVokjhfxjh dk loZlEekfur in NksM+&NksM+dj yksx bl foHkkx dh cjoaQnkth djrs Fks"* help deduce its precise meaning in the colonial office context.
questions.a: Morphologically: *cjoaQ* (tour/inspection) + *nkth* (agent suffix, like *karkarta*) → "one who tours/inspects." Syntactically: it is the object of *djrs Fks* (used to do) and modified by *foHkkx dh* (of the department). Context: people "NksM+&NksM+dj" (peering/straining necks) to watch the *in* (procession/arrival). Inferred meaning: *cjoaQnkth* = "inspecting officer / touring official / departmental inspector." A student answering "traveler" misses the official, authoritative nuance required by *foHkkx dh* and the subordinates' anxious posture.

questions.q: Evaluate the claim: "In *Ued ka Nakjksxk*, the word *vdkjFk* (in *i<+uk&fy[kuk lc vdkjFk x;k*) means merely 'compulsion.' Defend or refute using thematic evidence from the story's climax."
questions.a: Refute. *vdkjFk* here means "inescapable necessity born of existential crisis," not mere external compulsion. Thematic evidence: The narrator says this *after* Iftar Bahadur's suicide, when the father (Ojha) finally sends the son to school—*blh le> ij* (on this very understanding). The "necessity" is the realization that literacy is the only weapon against the dehumanizing bureaucracy that killed Iftar. *vdkjFk* carries the weight of *moral imperative* + *survival strategy*. A student calling it "force" ignores the agency shift: the father *chooses* education as resistance, making *vdkjFk* an internalized resolve, not external pressure.

questions.q: Create an original sentence using *rtoh"k* (will/testament) that mirrors the legal-finality tone of *"fMIVh eftLVªsV us viuh rtoh”k esa fy[kk"* (Mrs. Edwards wrote in her will) and embed a context clue of the *definition type* that would help a peer infer its meaning.
questions.a: Sample answer: *"The zamindar dictated his rtoh”k—a legal document declaring the distribution of his estate after death—to the munim in the presence of two witnesses."* The embedded definition clue is the appositive phrase *"a legal document declaring the distribution of his estate after death."* A weak answer would use *rtoh"k* loosely as "wish" (e.g., "It was his rtoh”k to eat mangoes"), missing the juridical gravity Premchand attaches to it when Mrs. Edwards' will *legally* secures Iftar's pension—a pivotal plot turn.
